name: Sculptor Dwarf
tagline: A metal-poor Milky Way spheroid 290,000 light-years out — dark-matter dominated, over 10 billion years old.
history: Shapley discovered Sculptor in 1937 on photographic plates — the first dwarf spheroidal ever found, a wholly new kind of galaxy made of a diffuse smear of old stars. Its stars are among the most metal-poor anywhere, so it must have formed most of them in the universe's first billion years. Velocity measurements show Sculptor is held together by far more unseen mass than starlight — a classic dark-matter-dominated dwarf.
